trigger: Trump threatened tariffs on all US steel/aluminium imports
magnitude: High negative: proposed 25% duties; reciprocal tariffs also threatened.
reason: Lower metal export competitiveness and risk of redirected supply can depress Indian producers; broader trade uncertainty raises risk premia.
timing: Sunday 9 Feb US comments / early 10 Feb IST precede Indian open; later recap corroborates. Signing on 10 Feb US time is not used.

trigger: Steel/aluminium tariff formalisation; positive US equities offset
magnitude: High policy risk, mixed market cue: 25% duties; GIFT roughly +20 points.
reason: Tariff escalation can hurt metals and global growth, while positive overnight equities argue against a simple risk-off explanation. Formal order time needs checking against 09:00 IST.
timing: 11 Feb 07:29 IST report supports mixed cues; later CBP record verifies 10 Feb proclamation date, not exact IST release time.

trigger: Weak overnight global equities; tariff uncertainty
magnitude: Moderate negative sentiment: GIFT about 80-point discount.
reason: Global weakness can reduce Indian risk appetite and reinforce existing foreign-outflow concerns. Sector losses during session do not establish a separate premarket event.
timing: 21 Feb 07:29 IST premarket report; 20 Feb overseas session within window.

trigger: Weak Monday Asian sentiment following Friday Wall Street selloff
reason: Regional risk aversion can transmit to India through capital allocation and exporter valuations. Friday US selloff itself is older than the strict Sunday window.
timing: 24 Feb 07:13 IST report confirms fresh Asian indications; Friday news separately treated as background.

trigger: US tariff escalation and sharp technology selloff
magnitude: High negative: Nasdaq -2.78%, Nvidia -8.5%; additional 10% China tariff signalled; claims 242k vs 221k expected.
reason: Trade/growth fears and US tech repricing can depress Indian IT earnings multiples and global risk appetite; several simultaneous shocks prevent unique attribution.
timing: 28 Feb 06:59 IST report covers 27 Feb US news and closes; all before cutoff.

trigger: Mixed premarket cues and oversold rebound setup; China stimulus hypothesis
magnitude: Moderate positive/mixed: target around 5%; NIFTY had fallen ten sessions.
reason: Asian resilience and China stimulus hopes may support metals, but verified premarket futures leaned negative. China announcement details lack independently verified cutoff timing, so positive close is not strongly explained.
timing: Mint 5 Mar 2025 07:30 IST outlook verifies GIFT about -70 points. China policy details treated only as unverified candidate, not an accepted cutoff-certified shock.

trigger: US auto-tariff delay and easing trade-tension hopes; China stimulus backdrop
magnitude: Moderate positive: US tariff-delay news lifted overnight equities; China 5% growth target supportive.
reason: A temporary auto-tariff reprieve reduces near-term supply-chain damage and lifts global risk appetite; China support expectations can aid metals. Several concurrent channels limit unique attribution.
timing: Mint overnight digest published 6 Mar 2025 07:09 IST explicitly covers Trump tariff delays and overnight US rally.

trigger: Second overnight US equity rally and supportive global risk appetite
magnitude: Moderate positive: GIFT near 22,727.5 vs prior NIFTY close around 22,509.
reason: Global equity strength can support Indian buying and reversal of bearish positioning; domestic session flows cannot be used as a known morning cause.
timing: 18 Mar 08:07 IST / 07:41 IST reports; overnight 17 Mar US rally eligible.

trigger: Fed retained two 2025 rate cuts; slower balance-sheet runoff
magnitude: High/moderate positive relief: rates held; easing projections retained.
reason: Reassurance on future easing can support EM flows and equity valuations despite tariff inflation concerns. Unchanged rates were expected; forward guidance is the more relevant surprise.
timing: 19 Mar 14:00 EDT release = 19 Mar 23:30 IST; official implementation note and later Indian recap corroborate.

trigger: Prior-session foreign investors returned as net buyers; global cues mixed
magnitude: Moderate positive positioning: 20 Mar FPI buying INR 3,239.1 crore vs DII selling INR 3,136 crore.
reason: Foreign demand can ease persistent outflow concerns and support large caps; offsetting domestic sales and mixed Asia reduce confidence. Flows are endogenous evidence, not an external shock.
timing: 21 Mar 07:29 IST report gives 20 Mar provisional flows and early Asia.

magnitude: Moderate positive background; prior Friday FII purchases approximately INR 7,470 crore.
reason: Less severe expected tariffs and improving foreign demand can support valuation recovery. Friday flows are outside Sunday-to-Monday window; no fresh Sunday shock independently established.
timing: 24 Mar morning outlook plus later flow recap. Prior-session Friday figures are background, not fresh eligible releases.
status: B03 | Reviewed - no fresh eligible trigger

trigger: Weak US consumer confidence despite positive equities / tariff-flexibility hopes
magnitude: Moderate mixed: early GIFT +0.34%; US equities recovered late.
reason: Consumer pessimism can raise export-demand concerns, but premarket risk cues leaned positive. Negative close cannot be uniquely attributed to those mixed signals; profit taking is an inference.
timing: 26 Mar 07:14 / 07:46 IST premarket reports cover 25 Mar news.

trigger: Risk reduction ahead of 2 April reciprocal-tariff announcement
magnitude: Moderate negative uncertainty; overnight US mixed, Asian equities higher.
reason: Anticipated export barriers and US growth risk can depress IT valuations and trigger de-risking; morning global cues were mixed, limiting confidence. Actual tariff rates were not known yet.
timing: 1 Apr 07:03 / 08:11 IST reports; later 2 Apr US announcement excluded.

trigger: Tariff-cap / negotiation hopes after prior-day selloff
magnitude: Moderate positive/mixed: Treasury commentary suggested tariff rates could be negotiated down.
reason: A less damaging tariff interpretation can encourage a relief rebound, but uncertainty persisted. Actual 26% India tariff announced overnight into 3 Apr cannot explain 2 Apr close.
timing: Upstox setup updated 2 Apr 2025 07:48 IST, with Asian-market section at 07:00. Actual reciprocal-tariff announcement overnight into 3 Apr excluded.
